claims.statement: Tom Allen and Mike McCoole signed articles for a rematch, which the New York Clipper expected to draw more attention than any American prize fight in years.

The sealing cf another fistic document between
Mike McCoole a fom Lp eather

fights.notes: Rematch; the first fight is said to have been at Foster's Island, where the ring-side conduct was disgraceful. Date not given in the text. Same rematch as in 342.

notes: Hint corrected: the rematch was agreed (documents sealed), so it is a fight entry, not a challenge.
